newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products end higher with crude's rising tide.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products end higher with crude's rising tide.

text.p: NWE oil products ended higher on Thursday on the back of firmer crude oil futures.
Gasoline was generally firmer due to hedging activity against swaps, but trade was thin and little sign of trans-Atlantic movement.
Naphtha held firm with offers scarce but cheaper alternative feedstocks kept demand relaxed.
Gas oil was lifted by IPE futures nearly $2 a tonne stronger, but weaker premiums of 50 cents to $1 lessened the rise. Cargo premiums were unchanged in a thin market.

High sulphur cargo prices rose $3, following crude and futures, but no trade was heard done in a market worried at the durability of the technical rally. Barges were pushed up to $87 on a pricing play by one dealer before slipping back.
Low sulphur cargo markets were very quiet, traders said.
